retrievalProfile.description: A central photographic window framed by a monochromatic cyan-blue tropical illustration featuring palm trees and ocean waves.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central full-color photograph of two men on a wooden sailboat, encased in a thick, light-blue border illustrated with white-contoured palm trees and beach scenery. The typography is a highly stylized, interlocking black script positioned at the top center, overlapping both the frame and the photo.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photo window vs. illustrated border
Warm wood tones vs. cool cyan frame
Organic script vs. geometric square layout

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects are centered in the middle ground of the photographic inset, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, intricate script at the top center acts as the primary focal point, followed by the faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script, move down to the subjects' faces, then follow the diagonal lines of the ship's rigging outward to the palm tree border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The light blue border acts as a massive negative space frame, isolating the central action.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and tans (wooden boat and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key, bright values with a desaturated, hazy quality in the photo and a flat, graphic quality in the border.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke weight with high contrast
Letters are tightly packed and layered
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature large, circular loops
The 'F' and 'S' in the secondary line are exaggeratedly tall
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the ornate script with a clean, sans-serif metadata block in the bottom corner for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast flourishes and formal script feel.
Provides the necessary swashes and interlocking potential.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a central photo of two men on a vintage wooden sailboat. Surround this photo with a thick, light-blue border featuring white-contoured illustrations of palm trees and beach waves in a flat, graphic style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom, black, interlocking Spencerian script title at the top center, ensuring the flourishes overlap the top edge of the central photograph.

verificationChecks: Does the script feature interlocking flourishes?
Is the central photo framed as a square window?
Are palm trees visible in the border?

mustRedesign: Exact brand logos in the corner

mustAchieve: Soft, sun-drenched lighting in the photo
Clean, graphic separation between border and photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s color grading (warm yellows/browns in photo)
Ensure the script is solid black and centered
Verify the palm trees are stylized, not realistic
Confirm the square layout is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Central photo + Monochromatic tropical border + Overlapping ornate script = Yacht Rock Aesthetic
